candidate_policy: Any positive vote or negative/unknown disagreement between successful covering single windows; failed windows do not create proposals. Bridge <=7 original missing days; observed non-proposals separate candidates. Candidates are not activity labels.
confirmation_policy: Review every proposal; global raw image plus candidate raw crop with 45-day context; same REVIEW_TASK as prior run; no derivatives, signal text or labels; strict original coordinates, failed outputs remain unknown.
calendar_ablation: Only add exact original missing-day indices inside the enlarged plot; identical images, candidate targets and base prompt
schedule: Sorted cases and proposals, alternating visual-first and calendar-first between proposals
stage_policy: Same saved XGBoost, features and support mask; no fitting or threshold selection
outside_proposals: Retain cached strict negative and unknown judgments; every positive source day must be included in proposal coverage
limits: Previously viewed synthetic development records, AI-assisted correlated labels, one weak episode, one call per arm and proposal, offline features; no confirmatory or field-generalization claim
